key_insight: SARLO-80 introduces a new large-scale worldwide SAR–optical dataset at 80 cm resolution, designed to better support physically grounded multimodal learning by preserving SAR complexity and acquisition geometry. It fills a major data gap for training foundation models that can connect radar and optical imagery more faithfully.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the shortage of high-quality, public SAR–optical benchmarks that keep native SAR measurements, complex-valued information, and precise geometry. Existing datasets are often low-resolution and intensity-only, limiting their usefulness for advanced multimodal AI.
method: Curates a worldwide dataset pairing very-high-resolution SAR data with optical imagery.
Preserves complex-valued SAR measurements and native acquisition geometry instead of reducing SAR to intensity-only GRD products.
Builds the dataset at 80 cm resolution to enable more detailed cross-modal learning and benchmarking.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, SARLO-80 provides a stronger benchmark for developing and evaluating multimodal models that work across radar and optical domains. It should improve research on remote sensing, robust representation learning, and physically informed foundation models.
